description: Source code for MediaExtractorFactory class in Android, responsible for creating media extractors, managing plugins, and handling extraction logic.

classes.name: ExtractorPlugin
classes.description: Represents a media extractor plugin, including its definition, library handle, path, and UUID string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a media extractor, either locally or via remote service, based on system property.

methods.name: CreateFromService
methods.description: Creates a media extractor by autodetecting content type and selecting appropriate plugin.

methods.name: sniff
methods.description: Detects the best extractor plugin for the given data source based on confidence levels.

methods.name: RegisterExtractor
methods.description: Registers a new extractor plugin, replacing older versions if necessary.

methods.name: RegisterExtractors
methods.description: Loads extractor plugins from specified directories and registers them.

methods.name: loadExtractors
methods.description: Initializes and loads all available extractor plugins.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns supported media types/extensions, either locally or via service.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs information about registered extractors, with permission check.
